decisions: Accept Hema 534 with kan, root a→ī and āśa. The four Yama school histories remain distinct.
Accept three new masculine sense addresses licensed at 534. Lubdha stays on the inherited miser scope. Retain corrupt OCR as textual evidence on its own channel.
Keep Hema ke + śa hair and pal + āśa tree as grade and ownership controls.
Accept kit iśa with short a on the two distinct dental/retroflex root inputs.
Accept masculine and neuter for both grain-ear entries under Śrīvallabha. Amara anchors the kaṇiśa neuter individually.
Take the two Amarasudhā paths at their exact source scope. Keep the Śabdakalpadruma śī+ḍa route separately Open for detailed derivation.
Accept Nighaṇṭuśeṣa’s primary kaṇiśa. Its secondary e display keeps its exact glyphs and derivation Open.
Preserve as controls older Yama, hair and miser, and independently count only the new selected lexical keys.
